description: This file is a Python script implementing a Streamlit web app for chatting with documents using LlamaIndex and various language models (Gemini, OpenAI, custom). It includes functions for setting up service contexts, processing documents, and managing the chat interface.

methods.name: gemini_service_context
methods.description: Sets up a Gemini language model and embedding model, then configures the global service context.

methods.name: openai_service_context
methods.description: Sets up an OpenAI language model and embedding model, then configures the global service context.

methods.name: custom_model
methods.description: Sets up a custom model with OpenAI and GooglePaLMEmbedding, then configures the global service context.

methods.name: process_documents_for_gemini
methods.description: Processes documents in a directory to create or load an index for Gemini model querying.

methods.name: process_documents_for_openai
methods.description: Processes documents in a directory to create or load an index for OpenAI model querying.

methods.name: process_documents_for_custom
methods.description: Processes documents in a directory to create or load an index for custom model querying.

methods.name: app
methods.description: Main Streamlit app function that manages file uploads, model selection, document indexing, and chat interface.
